description: 54s sales call. Sales rep presents product to customer. Clear turn-taking.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Okay, let's start the meeting. Good morning everyone.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: So the purpose of today's call is to quickly discuss the product and see if it makes sense for your team.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Can you explain what exactly this product does?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Yeah, so it's basically a platform that helps manage workflows and reduce manual work.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Is this something that can integrate with our existing systems?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: It should integrate with most systems. Yes, although some setup might be required.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: I want to understand the pricing. It feels a bit expensive compared to alternatives.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Pricing is fixed, but many customers find value in the long run.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: What kind of support do you provide once we buy it?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: SupoV is mainly through tickets, and onboarding is provided initially.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: How long does implementation usually take?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Usually a few days, depending on complexity.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Alright, what would be the next steps from here?

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: I'll share the proposal and pricing details, and then you can review and get back to us.
